posts.title: HBM4 ramp and conventional memory ASPs dominate 2H earnings setup
posts.text: Samsung, SK hynix HBM4 push puts HBM and general memory pricing in the spotlight. TrendForce: conventional DRAM +13-18% QoQ, NAND +10-15%. HBM4 costs for NVIDIA cited at $31-32/GB vs HBM3e $17-18/GB. $MU $SKHY $DRAM
posts.author: @EhrmantrautCap_

posts.title: iPhone 18 Pro BOM up ~38% on soaring memory prices
posts.text: $MU $SKHY $DRAM $SNDK Driven by soaring memory prices, BOM cost of the 256GB iPhone 18 Pro ~38% higher. $AAPL may offset via margins. LPDDR/SOCAMM2 pulls Apple into the same wafer pool as AI servers.
posts.author: @TradexWhisperer

posts.title: Micron SCAs are 5-year take-or-pay with upfront cash
posts.text: $MU $DRAM Micron CBO: overwhelming SCA revenue is 5-year terms through 2030, binding take-or-pay, no contractual outs, backed by upfront cash and LCs. Structural shift vs the old memory cycle.
posts.author: @TradexWhisperer

posts.title: UBS: conventional DRAM, not HBM, is Micron's profit engine
posts.text: HBM is not Micron's biggest profit driver right now. Conventional DRAM is. UBS: $MU general DRAM GM 91% in August, HBM margins lag. HBM crowds out DRAM dies. $MU
posts.author: @SemiconductorsX

posts.title: YMTC NAND shipments now ahead of Micron and Kioxia
posts.text: Counterpoint: China's YMTC accounted for 14% of NAND flash shipments in Q2, behind Samsung 25% and SK Hynix 22%, but ahead of Micron and Kioxia (SCMP / Techmeme).
posts.author: @Techmeme

posts.title: CXMT STAR Market debut tops Tencent on AI-memory bid
posts.text: $CXMT overtook Tencent in market value after a 466%+ STAR Market debut. CXMT ~7.7% global DRAM share; Apple testing its memory. Export controls and consumer-memory slowdown remain downside risks.
posts.author: @kautiousCo

posts.title: Soft July CPI vs Hormuz deal doubts; AI spending lifts Korea
posts.text: US stocks mixed after soft July CPI supported a Fed hold, offset by Iran/Hormuz deal doubts. 10y yields and oil fell. AI spending lifted South Korean stocks into a technical bull market. Cautious on $TSLA.
posts.author: @garyblack00

posts.title: Oil slips on demand/inventory; Hormuz talks still stuck
posts.text: Oil prices slip as demand concerns and rising US stocks weigh. Losses limited by lack of progress on blocked Strait of Hormuz. Brent $88.07, WTI $82.31.
posts.author: @TheCradleMedia
